preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 500 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]) and all(1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 500 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]) and all(1 <= int(line.split()[2]) <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: All city indices (X_i, Y_i) are integers between 1 and N (inclusive), and all importance values (Z_i) are integers between 1 and 10^5 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) == M + 1 and all(len(line.split()) == 3 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: The input consists of exactly M + 1 lines: the first line contains N and M, and the next M lines each contain three integers (X_i, Y_i, Z_i).

preconditions.expression: N >= 3 and M >= 3 and M <= 10**4 and N <= 500
preconditions.description: The constraints on N and M are satisfied: 3 ≤ N ≤ 500 and 3 ≤ M ≤ 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(int(line.split()[0]) != int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: No road connects a city to itself (X_i ≠ Y_i for all roads).

preconditions.expression: any(all(int(line.split()[0]) == x and int(line.split()[1]) == y for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]) for x in range(1, N + 1) for y in range(1, N + 1) if x != y) or any(all(int(line.split()[0]) == y and int(line.split()[1]) == x for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]) for x in range(1, N + 1) for y in range(1, N + 1) if x != y)
preconditions.description: The graph is connected (there exists at least one path between any two distinct cities).

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer less than 10^9 + 7, representing the product of separation numbers for all unordered pairs of cities modulo 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= N and 1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= N and int(line.split()[0]) != int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: The output is derived from the input graph where cities are labeled from 1 to N, and no self-loops exist.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.split()[2]) <= 10**5 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: The output accounts for all road importance values (Z_i) in the range [1, 10^5].

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N and 1 <= y <= N and x < y for x in range(1, N + 1) for y in range(x + 1, N + 1))
postconditions.description: The product is computed over all unordered pairs of distinct cities (x, y) where 1 ≤ x < y ≤ N.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= separation_number(x, y) <= sum(int(line.split()[2]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]) for x in range(1, N + 1) for y in range(x + 1, N + 1))
postconditions.description: For each unordered pair of cities (x, y), the separation number is a non-negative integer bounded by the sum of all road importance values.

postconditions.expression: all(separation_number(x, y) == min(sum(int(line.split()[2]) for line in subset) for subset in good_subsets(x, y)) for x in range(1, N + 1) for y in range(x + 1, N + 1))
postconditions.description: The separation number for a pair (x, y) is the minimum sum of importance values of any good subset of roads, where a good subset is one whose removal disconnects x from y.
